name: 4 Seater Relaxing Set with Table
material: Nylon-look webbing fabric w/t powder coated steel frame. w/t polyester fabric cushion. Coffee table w/t 5mm-thick black silk screen printing glass
description: Let friends and family gather around in simple yet sleek style outdoors, thanks to this garden patio set. Comes with four pieces – two armchairs, a two-seater sofa and a dining table. All with steel frame for a tough and strong structure. Thick padded cushions on the seats and backs for comfort as you relax. A tempered glass on the long table adds a beautiful finish, with protective pads on each foot for balance.
